settings.recipe_description: A wonderful recipe that everyone will love.
settings.ingredients:
2 lbs. fresh broccoli florets
1⁄2 lb. carrots, grated
1⁄2 cup onion, diced
1 cup mushrooms (enoki, shitake, or another
mushroom), diced
2 Tbsp. Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1⁄2 tsp. salt
2 garlic cloves, crushed
2 Tbsp. fresh ginger, peeled and grated
(optional)
2-3 Tbsp. coconut aminos
settings.instructions:
Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
In a large bowl, combine olive oil, salt,
garlic, ginger, and coconut aminos, then
set aside.
Wash the vegetables thoroughly, prepare and add them to the large bowl.
Toss the mixture together and place in a 9''x13'' glass pan.
Cover with foil, being careful not to touch the vegetables with the foil. Bake for 30 minutes.
Take the vegetables out of oven, stir the mixture, and return it to oven for 10-15
minutes, or until the broccoli is tender.
Serve hot with a high-protein entrée and possibly an additional vegetable dish.
Refrigerate within 2 hours of serving and eat leftovers within 2 days.
